facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility

response.justification: MOC-2010-0022 was raised at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility on 3 January 2010 following 3 recorded events in the archive, including AF-2011-003, INC-2012-004 and INC-2025-010. The change request record covers 4 clauses across 4 controlled documents. The intent is to introduce a duty the documents in scope did not previously carry. The record reached the state merged in the change stream.
response.risk_note: No control is relaxed by this change; the residual risk position is unchanged or improved, and the critical safeguard set is preserved.
response.scope_note: The documents in scope are ALERT-2016-007, MOC-2026-0413, PRO-MEC-014 and PRO-OPS-032.
